description: Review manuscript chapters and propose high-value reviewer TODOs in a Markdown report.
prompt:
All supplied inputs are valid; use them directly.
You may write inside agent-data/ and are read-only elsewhere.

Act as a mathematical writing reviewer. Review every non-example file under the resolved paper target's chapters/ in full manuscript context. Find concrete defects in rigor, definitions, assumptions, proof bridges, references, notation, or exposition that warrant author TODOs. Preserve existing TODOs as evidence, avoid duplicates, and consolidate repeated issues with every affected location.

For each recommendation give severity, exact file and nearest section, evidence and impact, and exactly one proposed annotation in the form `\todo{{R: actionable note}}`. Reject vague notes and distinguish confirmed defects from author decisions.

Completion criteria: when the requested work and all required checks are complete, place a Markdown report with summary counts; recommended TODOs ordered by severity; consolidated cross-file issues; overlap with existing TODOs; and reviewed areas needing no action.

End every turn with exactly one JSON object containing only "task" and "message". Set "task" to "completed" only when all stated completion criteria hold; otherwise set it to "not completed" and explain the blocker or remaining work in "message". A completed "message" must be self-contained: include the complete current artifact for handler-owned outputs, or the concise changed-files, checks, and build summary for direct-edit outputs.
